handoffs.message: Acceptance packet complete. PR #2231 open with auto-merge. Please review: (1) all F2-F7 isolation IDs covered, (2) upstream dependency table accurate, (3) ISO-M05 no-broker-order negative assertion requirement documented, (4) F5 deferred items marked with dual-entry condition, (5) support-only boundary confirmed — no L1/runtime/registry changes. Changes requested: dependency map must include active parent dependencies AG-BE-ID-004 and AG-FE-ID-001/execute-plans surfaces; XR-05 verification must not point at nonexistent pantheon services/execute-plans path; packet should refresh stale pre-implementation gated wording now that parent AG-TEST-ID-001 PR #2230 is merged/in review.

Commit: 61b63202. Ready for re-review.

Changes requested: Section 3 still says 'Before the parent owner begins implementation'; update this remaining start-gate wording to finalization/closeout language so it aligns with §1 and §3A. Optional cleanup: sync packet header Status with the task's review-ready state before handoff.
Both reviewer change requests addressed (commit 93e982cd): §3 preamble changed from start-gate to finalization/closeout language; packet header Status updated to review-ready. Ready for re-review.
